field_text_formatted.value: Composer maps the tag to 1.0.0, so ^1.0 is the constraint you want. If you're stuck on PHP 8.1, 1.0.0-rc1 is the last release that runs there, but it carries bugs rc2 fixed and the security team doesn't cover release candidates. Moving to 8.2 is the better answer.
